tieuDeEn: Like baby birds just out of the nest growing their feathers, our parents hope we'll one day fly high; they buy pens and paper and send us to school so we grow into good people.

dichXuoi.vi: Con như chú chim non vừa rời tổ, lông cánh đang mọc. Cha mẹ mong một ngày con sẽ bay cao, bay xa.
dichXuoi.en: We are like baby birds that have just left the nest, with feathers still growing. Our parents hope that one day we will fly high and far.

dichXuoi.vi: Cha mẹ mong con thành công, thành người tốt. Vì thế cha mẹ mua bút, mua giấy, cho con đến trường đi học.
dichXuoi.en: Our parents hope we will succeed and become good people. So they buy us pens and paper and send us to school.

la.de: Viết đoạn văn 5–7 câu: Đôi cánh ước mơ của em.

Ước mơ của em là gì? Vì sao?
Cha mẹ đã chuẩn bị cho em những gì để đi học?
Em sẽ làm gì để đôi cánh của mình ngày càng vững?

baiHoc: Các bạn nhỏ như chim non đang mọc cánh.
Cha mẹ mong con mai sau bay cao, thành người tốt.
Trân trọng bút giấy, sách vở cha mẹ sắm cho.
baiHocEn: We are like baby birds growing our wings. Our parents hope we'll fly high and become good people. Treasure the pens, paper and books they give us.
viecTot: Tuần này, em sắp xếp, bọc lại sách vở gọn gàng và nói lời cảm ơn bố mẹ đã sắm đồ dùng học tập cho em.
en: Cô Hà welcomes you to lesson twelve of “Lên Tám”. Last time she compared you to young green rice full of your parents' hopes. Today there's another lively image – baby birds learning to fly – to understand how parents prepare us for life. Listen carefully.
Like a bird just out of its nest, its feathers and wings still growing, your parents hope that one day you will soar.
They hope you will make a good life, hope you will become a good person; they buy you pens and paper and send you out to school.

The poem compares eight-year-olds to baby birds that have just left their warm nest and are taking their first steps into the world. Your wings are still soft, but they grow a little stronger with every lesson and every piece of advice from your teachers. Your parents dream of the day you'll have strong wings and fly high in the sky of knowledge, reaching your own dreams.

To help you fly, parents take real action. “Nên đời” and “nên người” mean succeeding and being a good person, and the key to that future is learning. However hard life is, your parents save every bit of money to buy pens, paper, books and new clothes, and send you to school to learn from teachers and friends. Every page and every pen holds their sweat and love. Treasure them and study hard.
